question: What literal native areas and source-declared channel percentages are supplied in the reviewed 14-area/13-percentage R2 blocks?
decision: Return the reviewed bounded source descriptions and combined disposition for T1-B inspection; no declaration of whole-scope completion or scientific acceptance.
strongest_rival: Conflating unobserved/invalid target channels, declared units and complete-vector normalization; incorrect source maps or treating unknown sample-label independence as biological replication.
discriminator: Exact frozen source coordinates, unit/isotope literals and full sample maps; independent target-channel domain/full-n checks; separate completeness/subtotal/unchanged numerical closure diagnostics. No mechanism is identified.
exposure_record: All T0 published outcomes/figures and metadata and all T1-A numerical source values, summaries, figures, missing channels and strict closure holds are exposed. The reviewer explicitly authorized a literal-channel endpoint after this exposure. R2 text headers/sample maps and published figures were exposed, but no R2 numerical extraction/summary was performed before this new freeze. Synthetic endpoint tests contain invented values. Neither amendment nor freeze creates confirmation or independent replication.
biological_unit: Deposited Hamanaka fibroblast source sample strings: four supplied suffix observations per condition, except Figure 4F three. Biological donor/preparation/well identity, independence and pairing remain unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Multiple isotope channels and metabolites repeat each sample label. Source workbook and article are one evidence lineage. Matching suffixes are not pairs; no donor population inference or cross-medium pooled effect.
population_and_selection: Exactly the reviewed 14 area and 13 percentage blocks in Figures 3F/4B/4F, 2072 cells. All 3F argininosuccinate percentages and all 4B putrescine are excluded by ambiguous source mapping, without numerical inspection/repair. 4F retains three actual labels.
contrast: Per-isotope/condition unweighted source means and observed ranges; descriptive TGF-beta minus UT only when both full supplied-n channel summaries qualify. Percentage differences use percentage points; areas retain native source units. No pairing or cross-medium/metabolite pooling.
endpoint: Literal source-reported isotope-channel percentage in explicit declared percent units, independently of vector normalization. R2 additionally describes native peak areas. 4F wording is Peak Area/Percent, not explicitly corrected. Counts/means/ranges only; missing other channels do not invalidate a fully supplied target channel.
methods: Reuse the frozen T1-A XLSX-XML reader; retain original raw/type/formula/value, unit/isotope/sample/group cell provenance. Numeric finite percentages must lie in [0,100]; native areas must be nonnegative. Full supplied n (4, or 3 for 4F) and all exact headers/labels are required for each channel summary. Decimal arithmetic. Vector QC is separate: complete sums/residuals versus explicitly incomplete valid-channel subtotals; unchanged 64*n*binary64_ulp(100) diagnostic only, with no normalization validation or rescaling. R1 retains every original v1 vector diagnostic verbatim as JSON records and its file hash. Unstacked supplied dots, full-n means/ranges, held annotations; no partial-n means. Independent openpyxl/math.fsum verification plus new endpoint boundary tests; reuse prior valid parser/tests.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep every whitelisted cell including missing, nonnumeric/nonfinite/formula, negative and out-of-domain values. Hold the affected target-channel summary, never reduce supplied n or impute/clip/renormalize. A missing neighbor leaves target-channel description possible but full-vector completeness unresolved. Unit/sample/isotope mismatch holds the affected block. R2 source-map exclusions and 4F n/SD/SEM plus D4/Methods tracer conflicts persist.
multiplicity: Not applicable: no biological hypothesis tests, significance selection or population confidence intervals.
precision_basis: Observed ranges describe supplied source labels, not population uncertainty or power. Fixed vector diagnostic tolerance is unchanged from T1-A and unrelated to biological margins; no precision inferred from decimal length or tuning to outcomes. Actual independent-unit variance/margins/sample size remain unknown.
interpretation_limit: Exposed shared-source description, not validated normalized composition, independent biological replication, calibrated concentration, exact unspecified abundance/error-bar replay, source ARG1 effect, collagen incorporation/transfer, flux, necessity or mature repair. All original T1-A vector/summary holds remain unchanged. Native B1 nutrient key, collagen/Lee values and original spatial/human/X3-X5 holds persist.
stop_rule: Execute only newly authorized R1 reported-channel companion and exact R2 descriptions; independently verify and return combined disposition for T1-B review. Do not rerun reviewed R1 areas/B1, T2/Atg5 searches, original Yadav analyses, raw-MS, proxies, outreach or bench work. No remote/Notion writes or whole-scope completion before review.
amendment_reason: First numerical R2 contract, implementing the previously design-only R2_DESIGN.md after explicit REVIEW_T1A authorization. Uses the same reviewed literal-channel separation as the R1 amendment; supersedes pending execution status, not historical artifacts or ambiguous-map holds.
